caveats: This baseline intentionally encodes ONLY metrics that demonstrated cross-run stability on the capture host: rto_seconds_p99 (3-run variance ±2%) and rpo_loss_count (=0 across all runs). These metrics are durability/recovery contracts and are CI-gateable as-is.

WAL append throughput and replay-scaling throughput were measured in the same 3-run campaign (see docs/benchmarks/2026-05-01/BENCHMARK_REPORT.md §10) but showed run-to-run variance of 19-48% driven by dev-box filesystem-cache and background-load noise. Including them here with any threshold would either gate on noise (false positives) or use thresholds so wide they catch nothing. Excluded by design.

Re-introduce throughput metrics once captured on dedicated benchmark hardware or a CI runner with a controlled environment_class. Carry that capture as a separate dated baseline file with its own environment_class field.
When the dev-box bench environment changes (Rust version, OS, CPU governor, IO scheduler), capture a new baseline as a separate dated file under benches/baselines/.
There is no benches/baselines/latest.json in this commit by design — pinning by date forces explicit, reviewable baseline updates.
